# Mercury Found in Fish Sold in Atiaiaba

Tests commissioned by the Review found mercury above safe limits in river fish sold at the market in Atiaiaba. The fish were caught downstream on the Ibira. Researchers link the contamination to illegal gold dredges upstream.
